data.name: Haridas
data.gender_notes: Haridas is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Haridas means 'God's servant' in Sanskrit. This name is derived from the words 'hari' meaning 'God' and 'das' meaning 'servant'. Haridas is revered in Hindu mythology as a devoted devotee of Lord Vishnu. The name Haridas carries the meaning “God's servant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Haridas usually hope their child will grow to embody god's servant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for those who choose to serve and dedicate their lives to their deity.
data.etymology: Haridas belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's servant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haridas total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Haridas embodies the quintessential devotion and selflessness of a true Hindu. In Hindu culture, devotion to God is highly valued. Haridas is a reminder of the importance of remaining humbly devoted to the divine, serving the divine will with every breath and action. This name is also a source of inspiration for many Hindus, urging them to strive for greater devotion in their own lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Haridas symbolizes the ultimate goal of Hindu spirituality - to live a life fully dedicated to the service of God. It emphasizes the importance of recognizing the divine within oneself and others, and of offering oneself in service to that divine presence. Haridas’ story serves as a reminder of the potential for pure devotion, detachment, and selflessness that each individual possesses, and inspires us to cultivate these qualities within ourselves. By bearing this name, one takes on the responsibility of striving towards selfless devotion and living a life in service to the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Haridas, meaning "having the grace of Hari (Vishnu)", embodies the devotion and surrender to the divine will of Lord Vishnu. His name symbolizes the pure and selfless devotion, free from material desires and worldly attachments.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Haridas is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a great devotee of Lord Krishna. The name Haridas carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Haridas is associated with the Bhakti movement in Hinduism, where it is used to describe a devotee who has achieved a high level of spiritual realization.
